jobs.title: Senior GIS Data Analyst
jobs.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior GIS Data Analyst based in the United States.

This is a fully remote opportunity for an experienced GIS professional supporting the planning, design, construction, and maintenance of fiber and HFC network infrastructure.

The role focuses on creating, analyzing, maintaining, and improving geospatial data and digital mapping products used across the organization.

You will work extensively with ESRI technologies, ArcGIS Pro, ArcFM, geodatabases, spatial datasets, and network asset information.

The position combines technical GIS expertise with research, data quality, cartography, and cross-functional collaboration.

You will support internal stakeholders with complex mapping requests while helping ensure geospatial inventories remain accurate and aligned with GIS best practices.

The role also provides opportunities to contribute to GIS standards, technical projects, data modeling, and infrastructure planning initiatives.

Success requires strong analytical skills, attention to detail, customer focus, and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a dynamic environment.

Accountabilities

Support fiber optic and HFC network mapping activities using ArcGIS and ArcFM.
Develop, maintain, and improve GIS datasets, geodatabases, applications, and related spatial data infrastructure.
Collect, attribute, edit, clean, organize, and maintain spatial data and create digital and hard-copy map products.
Update parcel information using ArcGIS Pro, ArcMap, REGRID, and coordinate geometry techniques.
Provide advanced technical support for GIS-related projects, applications, and data requests.
Research county, state, and federal records and interpret maps, aerial imagery, construction as-builts, and other source documents to gather and validate spatial information.
Support the development of GIS specifications and standards for engineering, construction, maintenance, and operation of fiber and HFC routes.
Manage geospatial inventories of fiber and HFC infrastructure, including route assets, schematics, capacities, and operational status.
Apply knowledge of coordinate systems and geodetic projections when performing spatial analysis and related calculations.
Collaborate with Legal, Market Expansion, design teams, engineering groups, and other internal stakeholders to fulfill GIS mapping and data requests.
Ensure fiber infrastructure geospatial inventories are accurate, consistent, well maintained, and aligned with established GIS best practices.
Assist with GIS data and mapping requirements associated with regulatory, state, and federal initiatives, including map updates and challenge processes.
Manage competing priorities, respond to changing requirements, and deliver accurate work within expected timelines.
Provide responsive and professional internal customer support while communicating technical information clearly across different organizational levels.

Requirements

Bachelor’s degree with a focus on GIS or a related discipline.
At least 5 years of professional experience working with ESRI platforms, including ArcGIS and ArcFM, to access, manage, implement, and analyze spatial data.
Strong cartographic skills and demonstrated experience creating GIS products for digital and print presentation using ArcGIS Pro.
Experience producing or updating overlay maps showing boundaries, utility locations, topographic features, and other infrastructure information across different scales and coordinate systems.
Strong understanding of GIS data maintenance, spatial analysis, geodatabases, and relational database concepts.
Familiarity with ArcGIS Server, ArcGIS Online, and ArcFM.
Ability to interpret maps, aerial photographs, construction documentation, and other records to identify and validate spatial information.
Understanding of outside plant design and construction techniques is desirable.
Experience with Python and SQL is a plus.
Experience with MyWorld, AutoCAD, or additional ArcFM functionality is beneficial.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to investigate complex GIS and data issues.
Excellent attention to detail and a commitment to data accuracy and quality.
Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities and work effectively under changing requirements and deadlines.
Strong internal customer-service orientation, with a sense of urgency and the ability to communicate diplomatically with stakeholders at different organizational levels.
Strong communication, collaboration, and negotiation skills.
Ability to work independently while contributing effectively within cross-functional teams.

Benefits

Fully remote work opportunity within the United States.
Medical, dental, and vision insurance beginning upon employment.
Life insurance coverage for employees and eligible family members.
Paid time off, including vacation, holidays, and personal/sick days.
401(k) plan with a 100% company match from day one, up to 5% of eligible compensation.
Group legal plan with identity theft protection.
Tuition reimbursement of up to $5,250 during the first year.
Up to $75 per month toward cable and internet services in select areas.
Remote access to select premium channels.
Annual community-support initiatives benefiting organizations across the United States.
Associate recognition and awards programs.
Opportunities for career advancement and professional development.
Collaborative and inclusive work environment.

How Jobgether Works

to ensure your application is reviewed quickly, objectively, and fairly against the role's core requirements. Our system identifies the top-fitting candidates, and this shortlist is then shared directly with the hiring company. The final decision and next steps (interviews, assessments) are managed by their internal team.

We appreciate your interest and wish you the best!

Why Apply Through Jobgether?

Data Privacy Notice:
By submitting your application, you acknowledge that Jobgether will process your personal data to evaluate your candidacy and share relevant information with the hiring employer. This processing is based on legitimate interest and pre-contractual measures under applicable data protection laws (including GDPR). You may exercise your rights (access, rectification, erasure, objection) at any time.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. Company Overview

Check out this video and find out why our team loves to work here!

Join Us! CDM Smith – where amazing career journeys unfold.

Imagine a place committed to offering an unmatched employee experience. Where you work on projects that are meaningful to you. Where you play an active part in shaping your career journey. Where your co-workers are invested in you and your success. Where you are encouraged and supported to do your very best and given the tools and resources to do so. Where it’s a priority that the company takes good care of you and your family.

Our employees are the heart of our company. As an employer of choice, our goal is to provide a challenging, progressive and inclusive work environment which fosters personal leadership, career growth and development for every employee. We value passionate individuals who challenge the norm, deliver world-class solutions and bring diverse perspectives. Join our team, and together we will make a difference and change the world.

Job Description

Under direct supervision, performs basic to moderate complexity geologic/ seismic evaluations/fault rupture hazard and slope stability investigations/ hydrogeologic analysis (aquifer test analysis; geochemical analysis; geotechnical analysis; contaminant transport analysis etc.) in both surface and subsurface geologic conditions pertaining to water supply, contaminant and/or geotechnical assessments.

Activities may include well geologic logging, water sampling, surface geological mapping, aquifer testing and/or soils characterization and data compilation and evaluation Prepares cross sections, isoconcentration maps, and/or QA/QC analysis.
Develops draft evaluations and calculations for compliance with federal, state and local regulations.
Ensures that firm policies and practices are followed on all assessments.
Contributes to firm's TKM by developing white papers and technical design documentation of new or special case designs, studies, etc.
Submits technical papers and designs for publishing to technical journals.
Attends conferences, symposia, etc.
to improve the visibility of the firm's products and services in collaboration with applicable sales staff.

jobs.title: Intermediate Environmental Scientist/Geologist- Minot, ND
jobs.description:
At Jacobs, we're challenging today to reinvent tomorrow by solving the world's most critical problems for thriving cities, resilient environments, mission-critical outcomes, operational advancement, scientific discovery and cutting-edge manufacturing, turning abstract ideas into realities that transform the world for good.

Your impact

Candidate MUST BE based in or near Minot, North Dakota. No relocation assistance is offered for this role.

At Jacobs, we don’t just lead the development and implementation of environmental remediation and compliance solutions, we live it. Jacobs is currently seeking an Environmental Scientist or Geologist, you’ll primarily work in the field supporting a variety of teams from different disciplines (i.e., engineers, geologists, and consultants) and backgrounds. Safety will be your priority, as you lead and support safe “incident free” operations in the office and in the field.

Based in North Dakota, your tasks will include a mix of field work (90%) and office work (10%). Typical field work tasks include sampling groundwater and potentially other various mediums (soil, sediment, surface water, soil gas, air, etc.), activities related to installation, operation, and/or maintenance of remediation technologies, completing field paperwork to document activities on site, observing subcontractors (drillers, surveyors, etc.), and interacting with our clients. Typical office tasks include data entry, coordination/logistics for field efforts, sample packaging and shipping, and tasks aligned to health, safety, and environmental compliance. We’ll rely on you to complete tasks within schedule and budget and communicate the status of tasks to project managers.

At Jacobs, we’re invested in you and the environment around us. Bring your positivity, attention to detail, willingness to learn, and ability to work in a fast-paced environment, and we’ll help grow what drives you – to deliver the best environmental solutions, together. If you’re up for the challenge, we’ve been looking for someone just like you.

Here's what you'll need

4+ years equivalent experience

Experience with using Microsoft Office-based software

40-hr HAZWOPER certification or ability to obtain and maintain

Be physically fit to perform fieldwork within industrial facilities up to 90% of the time, and wear a respirator, if required

A valid driver’s license with no major infractions

Be able to participate in a random drug testing program, including hair follicle samples

TWIC (Transportation Worker Identification Credential) or ability to obtain and maintain

Ability to travel up to 75% of the time

Ideally, You’ll Also Have

Experience with sampling groundwater, and general comprehension or willingness to train on sampling other environmental medium (soil, waste, soil gas, and surface water)

Experience with installation, operation, and/or maintenance of remediation technologies, or at a minimum, willingness to cross train

Subcontractor oversight experience

Ability to lift and carry up to 50 lbs

Ability to communicate effectively verbally and in writing, and work collaboratively with internal team members and client facility stakeholders

Ability to follow written procedures with several steps

The physical and environmental demands required to perform the essential duties of this position include standing, walking, sitting, coordination, balance and agility demands, which may include the ability to stoop, kneel, squat, grasp, reach, perform repetitive hand movements. Additional demands may involve a specific level of dexterity, grip strength, climbing and cardiorespiratory demands. The work areas may be indoors, outdoors, have loud noise, active machinery, high pressure fluid systems, electrical equipment, heights and depths, fumes, air borne particles, noxious gases, and chemicals. The use of appropriate safety equipment will be mandatory in these areas to prevent hazardous exposures.

Our health and welfare benefits are designed to invest in you, and in the things you care about. Your health. Your well-being. Your security. Your future. Employees have access to medical, dental, vision and basic life insurance, 401(k) plan, paid time off (allocated plans start date 17 days per calendar year), seven paid holidays, and caregiver leave and the ability to purchase company stock at a discount as well as legally mandated benefits.

The base salary range for this position is $66,300.00 to $96,000.00; though will be paid hourly based on hours worked. Within the range, individual pay is determined by work location and additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or protected veteran status. Job posted on September 23, 2026. This position will be open for at least 3 days.

Onsite employees are expected to attend a Jacobs Workplace on a full-time basis, as required by the nature of their role.

Your application experience is important to us, and we’re keen to adapt to make every interaction even better. If you require further support or reasonable adjustments with regards to the recruitment process (for example, you require the application form in a different format), please contact the team via Careers Support.

jobs.description:
# Data Analyst

## About the Role

Jump is seeking an experienced **Data Analyst** to help drive better business decisions through thoughtful analysis, clear metric definitions, and strong cross-functional partnership. This role works closely with **Product, Engineering, Operations, Customer Success, and GTM teams** to answer high-impact business questions, translate ambiguity into structured analysis, and uncover insights that shape company strategy.

In addition to business-impact-focused analytics, you will contribute to building and maintaining clean analytical data models and reliable data transformations that support scalable reporting. You will join a small, high-impact data team with significant ownership and direct influence on how the company measures performance, prioritizes initiatives, and grows.

## Key Responsibilities

* Partner with cross-functional teams to define KPIs, answer strategic questions, and support data-driven decision-making.

* Build reporting and dashboards that drive action and business outcomes.

* Present analytical findings and insights clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.

* Perform exploratory data analysis to identify trends, risks, and growth opportunities.

* Define and maintain core business metrics to ensure consistency and alignment across teams.

* Support and improve dimensional data models, including fact tables, dimension tables, and star schemas, within the data warehouse.

* Build and maintain reliable data transformations to improve data accuracy and consistency.

* Improve data quality, documentation, and reporting standards.

* Contribute to forecasting, experimentation analysis, and predictive or inference modeling initiatives.

* Work cross-functionally to influence business stakeholders and drive measurable impact through data.

* Contribute to scalable, reliable analytical workflows and reporting infrastructure.

* Take ownership of projects and proactively identify opportunities to improve analytics processes.

## Required Qualifications

* **2–4 years of relevant professional experience** in Data Analytics, Analytics Engineering, or a similar role.

* Strong proficiency in **SQL**.

* Experience working with a **modern cloud data warehouse**.

* Experience performing exploratory data analysis and communicating actionable insights.

* Demonstrated ability to work cross-functionally and influence business stakeholders.

* Demonstrated ability to drive measurable business impact through data.

* Experience building **analytical data models**, not only dashboards or ad hoc analyses.

* Strong written and verbal communication skills.

* Proactive mindset and willingness to take on projects outside your comfort zone.

* Familiarity with data ingestion tools such as **Fivetran, Airbyte, Stitch, or similar**.

* Familiarity with analytics transformation tools such as **dbt, SQLMesh, or Dataform**.

* Familiarity with a modern BI platform such as **Tableau, Sigma, Looker, or similar**.

* Familiarity with version-controlled analytics workflows.

* Understanding of dimensional modeling concepts, including fact tables, dimension tables, and star schemas.

* Bachelor’s degree in **Computer Science, Statistics, Data Science, Mathematics, Engineering, or a related quantitative field**, or equivalent practical experience.

## Preferred Qualifications

* Experience building predictive or inference models.

* Experience building and maintaining data ingestion pipelines.

* Experience implementing data quality testing and documentation practices.

* Experience working with GTM teams to define and report on GTM metrics.

* Exposure to event-based or product analytics data.

* Experience using AI effectively in analytics workflows.

* Experience with modern analytics tooling beyond the core requirements.

## Skills & Competencies

* Data Analysis

* Exploratory Data Analysis

* SQL

* Cloud Data Warehousing

* KPI and Metric Definition

* Business Intelligence

* Dashboard and Reporting Development

* Dimensional Data Modeling

* Fact and Dimension Tables

* Star Schema

* Data Transformation

* Data Quality

* Data Documentation

* Forecasting

* Experimentation Analysis

* Predictive Modeling

* Inference Modeling

* Data Ingestion

* Cross-Functional Collaboration

* Stakeholder Management

* Strategic Analysis

* Business Impact Analysis

* Written and Verbal Communication

* Proactive Problem Solving

## Education & Experience

**Education**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Statistics, Data Science, Mathematics, Engineering, or another related quantitative field, or equivalent practical experience.

**Experience**

* 2–4 years of relevant professional experience in analytics.

* Relevant experience may include Data Analyst, Analytics Engineer, or similar roles.

## Work Arrangement & Schedule

* **Work Arrangement:** Fully Remote

* **Location:** United States

* Candidates must reside in the **USA**.

* **Team:** Engineering

* **Level:** Intermediate

* Headquarters: **Salt Lake City, Utah**

* The company would like remote employees to visit the headquarters occasionally to get to know the team.

# Senior Data Analyst

## About the Role

MNTN is seeking a **Senior Data Analyst** to join its **Business Analytics Engineering** team and support data-driven decision-making across the company. This role combines data analytics, data modeling, reporting, visualization, and incident investigation within a high-volume Connected TV and digital advertising environment.

You will work across MNTN’s platforms, databases, data pipelines, and advertising ecosystem to understand complex data flows and translate business and product logic into scalable analytical solutions. The role partners closely with teams and leadership across the organization to deliver trusted insights, actionable recommendations, reliable reporting, and sustainable SQL and Python solutions.

## Key Responsibilities

* Develop deep expertise in MNTN platforms, user interfaces, databases, data pipelines, and the advertising ecosystem.

* Analyze data sources, system dependencies, integration points, and business outcomes to support effective problem-solving.

* Design scalable data models that translate complex business and product logic into efficient, accurate datasets.

* Develop clean and reliable tables that support analytical and operational reporting.

* Conduct regular data analysis and deliver insightful reports to internal stakeholders.

* Build high-quality, repeatable dashboards and analytics solutions.

* Investigate, triage, and debug data incidents to identify root causes and recommend effective resolutions.

* Translate data findings into actionable insights and recommendations through cross-functional collaboration.

* Build scalable, maintainable, and well-documented **SQL and Python** solutions.

* Apply rigorous QA practices and data validation to maintain reporting accuracy.

* Support workflow automation, process improvement, knowledge sharing, and improved analytical practices.

* Independently drive ambiguous analytical requests through structured analysis and actionable recommendations.

* Manage multiple stakeholders, priorities, and deadlines in a fast-paced environment.

* **2+ years of experience in marketing analytics or product analytics.**

* **2+ years of experience with Tableau or a similar dashboarding/BI tool.**

* Experience working in **high-volume data environments with 100M+ records** or in data warehousing.

* Working knowledge of **database definition language** for creating and managing datasets.

* Working knowledge of **ETL concepts**.

* Advanced Excel/spreadsheet and analytical skills.

* Demonstrated experience creating data visualizations for reports and dashboards.

* Strong attention to detail and commitment to data quality and accuracy.

* Ability to manage multiple stakeholders and competing priorities.

* Ability to work independently and take ownership in a fast-paced, growth-oriented environment.

* Strong analytical, communication, organizational, and multitasking skills.

* Project management and organizational skills.

* **2+ years of experience in martech or adtech.**

* Demonstrated understanding of **ad buying, attribution, and advertising analytics**.

* Experience with workflow automation and analytical process improvement.

* Experience working with complex advertising data ecosystems.

* Marketing Analytics

* Product Analytics

* Business Analytics

* SQL

* Python

* Data Warehousing

* ETL

* Database Definition Language

* Tableau

* Data Visualization

* Dashboard Development

* Excel / Spreadsheets

* Data Quality and Validation

* Incident Investigation

* Root Cause Analysis

* Reporting and Analytics

* Workflow Automation

* Process Improvement

* Stakeholder Management

* Cross-Functional Collaboration

* AdTech

* MarTech

* Ad Buying

* Attribution Analytics

new_jobs.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior GIS Data Analyst based in the United States.

This is a fully remote opportunity for an experienced GIS professional supporting the planning, design, construction, and maintenance of fiber and HFC network infrastructure.

The role focuses on creating, analyzing, maintaining, and improving geospatial data and digital mapping products used across the organization.

You will work extensively with ESRI technologies, ArcGIS Pro, ArcFM, geodatabases, spatial datasets, and network asset information.

The position combines technical GIS expertise with research, data quality, cartography, and cross-functional collaboration.

You will support internal stakeholders with complex mapping requests while helping ensure geospatial inventories remain accurate and aligned with GIS best practices.

The role also provides opportunities to contribute to GIS standards, technical projects, data modeling, and infrastructure planning initiatives.

Success requires strong analytical skills, attention to detail, customer focus, and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a dynamic environment.

Accountabilities

Support fiber optic and HFC network mapping activities using ArcGIS and ArcFM.
Develop, maintain, and improve GIS datasets, geodatabases, applications, and related spatial data infrastructure.
Collect, attribute, edit, clean, organize, and maintain spatial data and create digital and hard-copy map products.
Update parcel information using ArcGIS Pro, ArcMap, REGRID, and coordinate geometry techniques.
Provide advanced technical support for GIS-related projects, applications, and data requests.
Research county, state, and federal records and interpret maps, aerial imagery, construction as-builts, and other source documents to gather and validate spatial information.
Support the development of GIS specifications and standards for engineering, construction, maintenance, and operation of fiber and HFC routes.
Manage geospatial inventories of fiber and HFC infrastructure, including route assets, schematics, capacities, and operational status.
Apply knowledge of coordinate systems and geodetic projections when performing spatial analysis and related calculations.
Collaborate with Legal, Market Expansion, design teams, engineering groups, and other internal stakeholders to fulfill GIS mapping and data requests.
Ensure fiber infrastructure geospatial inventories are accurate, consistent, well maintained, and aligned with established GIS best practices.
Assist with GIS data and mapping requirements associated with regulatory, state, and federal initiatives, including map updates and challenge processes.
Manage competing priorities, respond to changing requirements, and deliver accurate work within expected timelines.
Provide responsive and professional internal customer support while communicating technical information clearly across different organizational levels.

Requirements

Bachelor’s degree with a focus on GIS or a related discipline.
At least 5 years of professional experience working with ESRI platforms, including ArcGIS and ArcFM, to access, manage, implement, and analyze spatial data.
Strong cartographic skills and demonstrated experience creating GIS products for digital and print presentation using ArcGIS Pro.
Experience producing or updating overlay maps showing boundaries, utility locations, topographic features, and other infrastructure information across different scales and coordinate systems.
Strong understanding of GIS data maintenance, spatial analysis, geodatabases, and relational database concepts.
Familiarity with ArcGIS Server, ArcGIS Online, and ArcFM.
Ability to interpret maps, aerial photographs, construction documentation, and other records to identify and validate spatial information.
Understanding of outside plant design and construction techniques is desirable.
Experience with Python and SQL is a plus.
Experience with MyWorld, AutoCAD, or additional ArcFM functionality is beneficial.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to investigate complex GIS and data issues.
Excellent attention to detail and a commitment to data accuracy and quality.
Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities and work effectively under changing requirements and deadlines.
Strong internal customer-service orientation, with a sense of urgency and the ability to communicate diplomatically with stakeholders at different organizational levels.
Strong communication, collaboration, and negotiation skills.
Ability to work independently while contributing effectively within cross-functional teams.

Benefits

Fully remote work opportunity within the United States.
Medical, dental, and vision insurance beginning upon employment.
Life insurance coverage for employees and eligible family members.
Paid time off, including vacation, holidays, and personal/sick days.
401(k) plan with a 100% company match from day one, up to 5% of eligible compensation.
Group legal plan with identity theft protection.
Tuition reimbursement of up to $5,250 during the first year.

Associate recognition and awards programs.

Your impact

Candidate MUST BE based in or near Minot, North Dakota. No relocation assistance is offered for this role.

At Jacobs, we don’t just lead the development and implementation of environmental remediation and compliance solutions, we live it. Jacobs is currently seeking an Environmental Scientist or Geologist, you’ll primarily work in the field supporting a variety of teams from different disciplines (i.e., engineers, geologists, and consultants) and backgrounds. Based in North Dakota, your tasks will include a mix of field work (90%) and office work (10%). At Jacobs, we’re invested in you and the environment around us. Bring your positivity, attention to detail, willingness to learn, and ability to work in a fast-paced environment, and we’ll help grow what drives you – to deliver the best environmental solutions, together. If you’re up for the challenge, we’ve been looking for someone just like you.

4+ years equivalent experience

Experience with using Microsoft Office-based software

40-hr HAZWOPER certification or ability to obtain and maintain

new_jobs.description:
# Data Analyst

## About the Role

Jump is seeking an experienced **Data Analyst** to help drive better business decisions through thoughtful analysis, clear metric definitions, and strong cross-functional partnership. This role works closely with **Product, Engineering, Operations, Customer Success, and GTM teams** to answer high-impact business questions, translate ambiguity into structured analysis, and uncover insights that shape company strategy.

In addition to business-impact-focused analytics, you will contribute to building and maintaining clean analytical data models and reliable data transformations that support scalable reporting. You will join a small, high-impact data team with significant ownership and direct influence on how the company measures performance, prioritizes initiatives, and grows.

## Key Responsibilities

* Partner with cross-functional teams to define KPIs, answer strategic questions, and support data-driven decision-making.

* Build reporting and dashboards that drive action and business outcomes.

* Present analytical findings and insights clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.

* Perform exploratory data analysis to identify trends, risks, and growth opportunities.

* Define and maintain core business metrics to ensure consistency and alignment across teams.

* Support and improve dimensional data models, including fact tables, dimension tables, and star schemas, within the data warehouse.

* Build and maintain reliable data transformations to improve data accuracy and consistency.

* Improve data quality, documentation, and reporting standards.

* Contribute to forecasting, experimentation analysis, and predictive or inference modeling initiatives.

* Work cross-functionally to influence business stakeholders and drive measurable impact through data.

* Contribute to scalable, reliable analytical workflows and reporting infrastructure.

* Take ownership of projects and proactively identify opportunities to improve analytics processes.

## Required Qualifications

* **2–4 years of relevant professional experience** in Data Analytics, Analytics Engineering, or a similar role.

* Strong proficiency in **SQL**.

* Experience working with a **modern cloud data warehouse**.

* Experience performing exploratory data analysis and communicating actionable insights.

* Demonstrated ability to work cross-functionally and influence business stakeholders.

* Demonstrated ability to drive measurable business impact through data.

* Experience building **analytical data models**, not only dashboards or ad hoc analyses.

* Strong written and verbal communication skills.

* Proactive mindset and willingness to take on projects outside your comfort zone.

* Familiarity with data ingestion tools such as **Fivetran, Airbyte, Stitch, or similar**.

* Familiarity with analytics transformation tools such as **dbt, SQLMesh, or Dataform**.

* Familiarity with a modern BI platform such as **Tableau, Sigma, Looker, or similar**.

* Familiarity with version-controlled analytics workflows.

* Understanding of dimensional modeling concepts, including fact tables, dimension tables, and star schemas.

* Bachelor’s degree in **Computer Science, Statistics, Data Science, Mathematics, Engineering, or a related quantitative field**, or equivalent practical experience.

## Preferred Qualifications

* Experience building predictive or inference models.

* Experience building and maintaining data ingestion pipelines.

* Experience implementing data quality testing and documentation practices.

* Experience working with GTM teams to define and report on GTM metrics.

* Exposure to event-based or product analytics data.

* Experience using AI effectively in analytics workflows.

* Experience with modern analytics tooling beyond the core requirements.

## Skills & Competencies

* Data Analysis

* Exploratory Data Analysis

* SQL

* Cloud Data Warehousing

* KPI and Metric Definition

* Business Intelligence

* Dashboard and Reporting Development

* Dimensional Data Modeling

* Fact and Dimension Tables

* Star Schema

* Data Transformation

* Data Quality

* Data Documentation

* Forecasting

* Experimentation Analysis

* Predictive Modeling

* Inference Modeling

* Data Ingestion

* Cross-Functional Collaboration

* Stakeholder Management

* Strategic Analysis

* Business Impact Analysis

* Written and Verbal Communication

* Proactive Problem Solving

## Education & Experience

**Education**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Statistics, Data Science, Mathematics, Engineering, or another related quantitative field, or equivalent practical experience.

**Experience**

* 2–4 years of relevant professional experience in analytics.

* Relevant experience may include Data Analyst, Analytics Engineer, or similar roles.

## Work Arrangement & Schedule

# Senior Data Analyst

## About the Role

MNTN is seeking a **Senior Data Analyst** to join its **Business Analytics Engineering** team and support data-driven decision-making across the company. This role combines data analytics, data modeling, reporting, visualization, and incident investigation within a high-volume Connected TV and digital advertising environment.

You will work across MNTN’s platforms, databases, data pipelines, and advertising ecosystem to understand complex data flows and translate business and product logic into scalable analytical solutions. The role partners closely with teams and leadership across the organization to deliver trusted insights, actionable recommendations, reliable reporting, and sustainable SQL and Python solutions.

## Key Responsibilities

* Develop deep expertise in MNTN platforms, user interfaces, databases, data pipelines, and the advertising ecosystem.

* Analyze data sources, system dependencies, integration points, and business outcomes to support effective problem-solving.

* Design scalable data models that translate complex business and product logic into efficient, accurate datasets.

* Develop clean and reliable tables that support analytical and operational reporting.

* Conduct regular data analysis and deliver insightful reports to internal stakeholders.

* Build high-quality, repeatable dashboards and analytics solutions.

* Investigate, triage, and debug data incidents to identify root causes and recommend effective resolutions.

* Translate data findings into actionable insights and recommendations through cross-functional collaboration.

* Build scalable, maintainable, and well-documented **SQL and Python** solutions.

* Apply rigorous QA practices and data validation to maintain reporting accuracy.

* Support workflow automation, process improvement, knowledge sharing, and improved analytical practices.

* Independently drive ambiguous analytical requests through structured analysis and actionable recommendations.

* Manage multiple stakeholders, priorities, and deadlines in a fast-paced environment.

* Extensive **SQL** experience, including the ability to write scalable and maintainable queries.

* Working knowledge of **database definition language** for creating and managing datasets.

* Working knowledge of **ETL concepts**.

* Advanced Excel/spreadsheet and analytical skills.

* Demonstrated experience creating data visualizations for reports and dashboards.

* Strong attention to detail and commitment to data quality and accuracy.

* Ability to manage multiple stakeholders and competing priorities.

* Ability to work independently and take ownership in a fast-paced, growth-oriented environment.

* Strong analytical, communication, organizational, and multitasking skills.

* Project management and organizational skills.

* **2+ years of experience in martech or adtech.**
